archetype: Audience cluster page (spec section 8); Service rung lives naturally here (the owner decides for the people who depend on the business, never as ROI or outcome); Course/CourseInstance JSON-LD structure kept, text fields rewritten.

en.h1: From decisions in your head to decisions in writing.
en.lede: Owners carry client knowledge, pricing calls and operating control in their own heads. Across {FACTS.durationLong} the applied business project takes one operating issue — pricing, succession or a client dependency — from problem to a written plan with owners and measures, reviewed by faculty. It develops management capability; growth and return depend on the decisions and execution that follow. (This H1 and lede are the spec's own approved example for this route, section 8.)

ms.h1: Daripada keputusan di kepala kepada keputusan bertulis.
ms.lede: Pemilik menyimpan pengetahuan pelanggan, soal harga dan kawalan operasi di kepala sendiri. Sepanjang {FACTS.durationMonths} bulan, projek amali perniagaan membawa satu isu operasi — harga, penggantian atau pergantungan pelanggan — daripada masalah kepada pelan bertulis berserta pemilik dan ukuran, disemak oleh fakulti. Ia membina keupayaan pengurusan; pertumbuhan dan pulangan bergantung pada keputusan dan pelaksanaan yang menyusul.

zh.h1: 从脑中决策，到书面决策。
zh.lede: 企业主把客户认知、定价判断与运作控制权都留在自己脑中。{FACTS.durationMonths} 个月内，企业应用项目把一项运作课题——定价、接班或客户依赖——从问题推进到一份附带责任人与衡量指标、经导师评阅的书面方案。它锤炼管理能力；增长与回报取决于此后的决策与执行。
